violations.why: measure2 (prio 3) preempts measure1 between its increment and read, so the read sees 0 instead of the value it wrote.
communicate (prio 5) can preempt measure1 and reset tickCounter between the increment and the read.
measure2 can write tickCounter between measure1's read and its write of 0.
communicate preempts measure2 between the write and the check; the write is not guaranteed to be seen.
communicate can reset numberOfRecords between measure1 using it as an index and incrementing it, so the record is stored at a stale index.
communicate resets the count between measure1's index read and increment read.
The increment is not atomic, and communicate's reset of intervalCounter can fall between its read and write, so the reset is lost.
